observations: The lower Ф.1 graphic has a separate +20,875 callout near the beginning of the corner, distinct from the +20,840 callout by В-2; the upper corresponding finish graphic states К-3 +20,990.
The К-3 assembly visibly specifies 40 mm paving and 25–50 mm adjustable supports/air gap. The 30–230 mm range belongs to К-4, not К-3.
The 75 mm arithmetic residual is (20990−20875−40); it is not a proven product height without establishing reference surfaces, intermediate layers and support location.

Both prepared graphic stamps refer to АР6.2 and sections 2,3. An overview label section 1 does not alone prove the two sources are unrelated. Local applicability still needs checking; do not silently treat a shared mark as proof.
The drawing shows lower local levels near drains; these do not prove that every support requires that height or that procurement must include 110 mm supports.
assessment_boundary: Evaluator source check; not supplied to executing model. Supports a bounded clarification, not unconditional product incompatibility or full benchmark acceptance.
